title.hi: राज्य या केंद्रशासित प्रदेश की राजधानी

note.en: The thirty largest municipal corporations at the 2011 census, which is the last one taken. A corporation is not a metropolis: Mumbai's built-up area holds far more people than its own city limits, and Delhi, Thane and Vasai-Virar are all parts of larger conurbations.
note.hi: 2011 की जनगणना — अंतिम हुई जनगणना — के अनुसार तीस सबसे बड़ी नगर निगम सीमाएँ। निगम महानगर नहीं होता: मुंबई के बसे क्षेत्र में उसकी नगर सीमा से कहीं अधिक लोग रहते हैं, और दिल्ली, ठाणे तथा वसई-विरार सब बड़े नगरपुंजों के हिस्से हैं।

attribution: Municipal-corporation populations from the 2011 Census of India, as tabulated on Wikipedia's list of Indian cities by population; capitals and descriptions checked against each city's own article.
_size: A circle's area carries the population, so the sizer takes the square root of the value: twice the circle for four times the people. The engine reads size.field and this layer's own domain, never its name.
